name: Face Consistency Benchmark (FCB)
description: Video generation driven by artificial intelligence has advanced significantly, enabling the creation of dynamic and realistic content. However, maintaining character consistency across video sequences remains a major challenge, with current models struggling to ensure coherence in appearance and attributes. This paper introduces the Face Consistency Benchmark (FCB), a framework for evaluating and comparing the consistency of characters in AI-generated videos. By providing standardized metrics, the benchmark highlights gaps in existing solutions and promotes the development of more reliable approaches. This work represents a crucial step toward improving character consistency in AI video generation technologies.
evaluation_method: Automated identity-consistency metrics (face-embedding similarity / identity verification accuracy) combined with human_eval (perceptual consistency judgments)
general_score_metric: Identity-consistency score (automated face-similarity/verification metric) supplemented by human preference/consistency ratings
reputation: New benchmark addressing an active and emerging problem in video generation; early-stage adoption with interest from the generative-video research community.
notes: Contains privacy and demographic-bias risks common to face datasets; automated metrics may not align with human perception; dataset size/diversity and potential synthetic-data contamination can affect evaluation; sensitive ethical considerations around face data.
